summary: Centralize immutable stack and template release pairings
description: Implement the accepted reliability improvement as a self-contained verified patch release. Source: accepted five-point improvement advice. No model escalation, global skills, live consumer mutation or GitHub Actions.
acceptance: One validated manifest owns the existing historical stack-to-template release mappings, exact commits and current tested pairing; release hydration reads it without changing published historical tags.

A checker detects contradictory refs, invalid hashes, missing mappings and mismatched current template pins/docs; current version metadata can be rendered deterministically without rewriting historical evidence.
A fully completed verification capture with no in-flight operation or worker group does not block on a changed network hostname; uncertain/live processes remain blocked.
Ship the scoped change with current verification, critic, integration, immutable release and remote readback.
